role: Researches a question into a sourced report

ideas.promise: Ask me any question and I'll come back with a short answer and its sources.
Give me a PDF or Word file and I'll tell you what's in it in five lines.
ideas.ask: Summarise this document in five lines:

ideas.promise: Once a week I'll plan seven dinners everyone will actually eat, write the shopping list sorted by aisle, and put the shop day on your calendar. If you want, I'll fill the cart too — you approve it like any purchase.
ideas.ask: Plan our dinners for the week and write the shopping list

ideas.promise: I'll keep an ear out for your name and anything you told me to listen for — across Reddit, Hacker News, news sites and X — and send you one source-linked line when something shows up. Quiet otherwise.
ideas.ask: Watch for my name online and tell me when something shows up

ideas.promise: I'll read the letters and forms coming into your mail, put what's due on your calendar, and draft every reply — you read, tap approve, and send.
ideas.ask: Sort the paperwork: what's due, and draft the replies

ideas.promise: I'll turn your mail, your calendar and what's still open into what today actually is.
ideas.ask: Give me my day: what's on, what's waiting on me, what to do first

ideas.promise: I'll catch a renewal or a price rise before it's charged, and have the cancellation email ready. Every step asks you first, on its own card.
ideas.ask: Watch my subscriptions so nothing gets renewed without me hearing about it first

ideas.promise: I'll keep an eye on what you just bought, and tell you the day you can claim the money back. I'll do it end to end — you just tap approve.
ideas.ask: Watch something I bought and tell me when I can claim the difference back

ideas.promise: I'll search the government's unclaimed-money registers for our family's names and get the claims ready to file. I'll file it end to end — you just tap approve.
ideas.ask: Search for money owed to us that nobody has claimed

ideas.promise: I'll set up the return, keep the label, and keep checking until the shop says the refund is on its way. Every step asks you first, on its own card.
ideas.ask: Help me return this and get the refund

ideas.promise: Give me the names of the others doing what you do. I'll watch their pages and newsletters, and once a week you get one short brief: what changed, what it means, what you could do about it. I never contact anyone.
ideas.ask: Watch my competitors and give me a weekly brief

ideas.promise: Once a month I'll write the short story of what happened in our world — the topics, names and places you care about — with a link for every claim, as a document you keep.
ideas.ask: Write me the month in brief
